title: Service menu and maintenance intervals, effective 1 March 2026
text: This menu applies at both service departments, Harlan Falls and Brookmere, from 1 March 2026 and replaces the menu dated 1 January 2024. Prices include parts, labor and shop supplies but not sales tax. Full synthetic oil and filter change: $94.95 for Vantrell gasoline engines taking up to 6 quarts, and $129.95 for the Tarrant 3.5 V6 and all diesel engines. Conventional oil is no longer offered, because every Vantrell engine built since 2019 requires 0W-20 or 0W-30 full synthetic. Every oil change includes a tire rotation and a multi-point inspection at no extra charge. Tire rotation on its own is $39.95. Engine air filter $54.95; cabin air filter $64.95. Brake fluid exchange $159.95, recommended every 3 years regardless of mileage. Coolant exchange $199.95, first at 100,000 miles and then every 50,000 miles. Four-wheel alignment $149.95. Maintenance intervals: Vantrell's schedule calls for an oil change every 7,500 miles or 12 months, whichever comes first, under normal driving. Under severe service, meaning regular towing, mostly trips under 5 miles, dusty or gravel roads, or long periods of idling, the interval drops to 3,750 miles or 6 months. The oil life monitor can be followed instead, but never beyond 12 months between changes. Express oil changes without an appointment are available at Brookmere only, Monday to Friday 7 am to 3 pm.

title: Service menu, effective 1 January 2024 (superseded)
text: Status: superseded on 1 March 2026 by the current service menu. This page is kept for customers checking older invoices and service records. Under the 2024 menu, a full synthetic oil and filter change cost $84.95 for gasoline engines and $114.95 for the Tarrant V6 and diesel engines. A conventional oil change was still offered at $59.95 for models built before 2019. Tire rotation was charged separately at $29.95, even when done with an oil change. Engine air filter $49.95; cabin air filter $59.95. Brake fluid exchange $139.95, recommended every 2 years. Four-wheel alignment $129.95. The oil change interval printed on this menu was 5,000 miles or 6 months for normal driving and 3,000 miles for severe service; Vantrell lengthened its factory schedule in 2025, and the current menu reflects the new intervals. Service coupons issued under the 2024 menu are honored until 31 May 2026, but they are applied to the current prices, not the old ones. Express service at Brookmere under this menu ran Monday to Saturday; Saturday express service ended when the current menu took effect.

title: Diagnostic fees, warranty diagnosis and recalls
text: Customer-pay diagnosis is charged at a flat $179 for the first hour. That covers most warning lights, including a steady check engine light, and includes a road test and a written report listing the trouble codes and our recommendation. Electrical faults, intermittent problems and water leaks often need longer and are billed at $179 per hour after the first hour; we will call you for approval before going past the first hour. The diagnostic fee is credited toward the repair only if you authorize the repair before the vehicle leaves our lot. If you take the vehicle home and come back later to have the repair done, the diagnostic fee is not credited, even if you return the next day, because the vehicle has to be checked again. Diagnosis is free when the fault turns out to be covered by the factory warranty, a Vantrell Certified warranty or an open recall. Recall repairs are free for every Vantrell vehicle, wherever it was bought, and we check for open recalls on every vehicle that comes in for service. Recall work needs its own appointment when parts have to be ordered; parts usually arrive within 5 to 10 business days. If a recall notice says do not drive, call us and we will tow the vehicle in from up to 50 miles at no charge and provide a loaner until the repair is done.

title: Courtesy shuttle and loaner vehicles
text: Both service departments run a free courtesy shuttle within a 10-mile radius, Monday to Friday 7:30 am to 5 pm; the last pickup run to bring you back from home or work leaves at 4:15 pm. There is no shuttle on Saturdays. Loaner vehicles are provided at Harlan Falls only, and only in these cases: warranty or recall repairs expected to keep the vehicle overnight, collision repairs on insurance claims where your policy does not include a rental car, and every plan visit for holders of a CarePath Plus prepaid plan. Loaners are not provided for customer-pay oil changes, tire work or other routine maintenance; for those you can wait in the lounge, which has wifi, or use the shuttle. To take a loaner you must be at least 21, show a valid driver's license, and show proof of full-coverage insurance, which is primary while you drive it. Loaners are limited to 100 miles per day, with $0.40 per mile charged over that. Return it with the same fuel or charge level, or a refueling charge of $7.50 per gallon applies. Tolls, parking tickets and camera fines incurred during the loan are passed on with a $25 admin fee. No smoking and no pets; a cleaning fee of $150 applies. Loaners must be returned within 24 hours of your own vehicle being ready, after which $45 per day is charged.

title: CarePath prepaid maintenance plans
text: CarePath plans let you pay for scheduled maintenance upfront at today's prices. CarePath Basic costs $599 and covers 4 full synthetic oil changes with tire rotation and multi-point inspection over 3 years or 30,000 miles, whichever comes first. CarePath Plus costs $1,149 and covers 6 visits over 4 years or 45,000 miles, adding engine and cabin air filters every other visit, one brake fluid exchange, wiper blades once a year and a loaner vehicle at every plan visit. Plans can be bought with a new or pre-owned vehicle, or within 90 days of purchase for any Vantrell vehicle under 15,000 miles, and can be included in a vehicle loan. Plans are honored only at the Corrigan & Pike service departments in Harlan Falls and Brookmere. CarePath plans are non-refundable once the first plan service has been used, including when the vehicle is sold, traded in or declared a total loss. Instead, the remaining visits transfer automatically and free of charge to the next owner of the vehicle, whether that is a private buyer or a dealer. If no plan service has been used, a plan can be cancelled within 60 days of purchase for a full refund. Unused visits do not roll over once the time or mileage limit is reached. Any repairs found during a plan visit are quoted separately and are not covered by the plan.

title: Vantrell Certified Pre-Owned program
text: Vantrell Certified Pre-Owned vehicles are Vantrell models up to 6 model years old with fewer than 80,000 miles, a clean title and a passed 182-point inspection. Each certified vehicle comes with two warranties. Comprehensive coverage, sometimes called bumper to bumper, lasts 12 months or 12,000 miles from the date of your certified purchase, whichever comes first. Powertrain coverage, for the engine, transmission and drive axles, lasts 7 years or 100,000 miles from the vehicle's original in-service date, whichever comes first. There is a $100 deductible per repair visit, waived when the repair is done at one of our own service departments. Certified vehicles also get 24-hour roadside assistance for the length of the comprehensive coverage and a free first oil change within 6 months of purchase. Transfer rules: only the powertrain coverage transfers when the vehicle is sold privately, and only if a $75 transfer fee is paid within 30 days of the sale; the comprehensive coverage and roadside assistance end on the date of a private sale. If the vehicle is traded in to any Vantrell dealer, the remaining coverage stays with the vehicle at no charge. Every certified vehicle is delivered with a full detail, two keys and new wiper blades, and is sold from the Brookmere pre-owned center or online.

title: Select Assurance limited warranty on non-certified pre-owned vehicles
text: Pre-owned vehicles of other makes, and Vantrell vehicles that do not qualify for the certified program, may be sold with our own Select Assurance limited warranty, provided they are under 10 model years old and under 120,000 miles. Select Assurance covers the engine, transmission and drive axles only, for 90 days or 4,000 miles from the date of purchase, whichever comes first. There is a $250 deductible per repair visit, and covered repairs must be done at Harlan Falls or Brookmere; repairs done elsewhere are not reimbursed unless the vehicle breaks down more than 100 miles away and we approve the repair beforehand. Select Assurance does not include roadside assistance and cannot be transferred to a later owner. Vehicles over 10 model years old or over 120,000 miles are sold as-is, with no dealer warranty, and the window sticker says so. An optional extended service contract can be added to a Select Assurance or as-is vehicle at the time of sale; it is administered by a third-party company, has its own terms and deductible, and is not the same as certified coverage. Select Assurance vehicles get a 120-point inspection, a standard detail and at least one key.

title: Pre-owned vehicle 7-day exchange promise
text: Every pre-owned vehicle we sell, certified or not, comes with a 7-day exchange promise, except vehicles sold as-is. If you are not happy with the vehicle for any reason, you can bring it back within 7 days of delivery and 300 miles, whichever comes first, and exchange it for another vehicle from our pre-owned stock. This is an exchange, not a return: no cash refunds are given, and the full purchase price, including any trade-in allowance, is credited toward the replacement vehicle. If the replacement costs more, you pay or finance the difference; if it costs less, the difference is refunded by check within 10 business days. The vehicle must come back in the same condition as at delivery, with no new damage, no aftermarket modifications, and all keys, manuals and accessories. A $295 exchange processing fee applies, which covers re-titling and re-registration. Only one exchange is allowed per purchase. Exchanges are handled at the Brookmere pre-owned center by appointment, Monday to Saturday. Federal law does not give buyers a cooling-off period on vehicle purchases; this promise is our own policy, and its terms are set out in the buyer's agreement you sign at delivery.

title: Factory orders, deposits and price protection
text: New Vantrell vehicles that are not in our inventory can be ordered from the factory through the Harlan Falls sales team. A factory order needs a $1,000 deposit, paid by debit card, credit card or cashier's check. The deposit is fully refundable until the order is scheduled for production, which usually happens within 10 days and is confirmed to you by text and email. Once the order is scheduled, the deposit is non-refundable, but it can be applied to any other new or pre-owned vehicle purchase from us within 6 months. If the vehicle arrives more than 90 days after the estimated build week we gave you, you may cancel and the deposit is refunded in full. Price protection: the agreed price on the order is not locked. If the factory raises the MSRP before your vehicle is built, the increase is passed on at cost, and we will tell you in writing before delivery; if the increase is more than $1,000 you may cancel for a full refund of the deposit. If the factory lowers the price or adds an incentive, you get the lower price. Delivery is at Harlan Falls with a one-hour orientation; home delivery within 40 miles costs $150. In-stock vehicles can be held for 48 hours with a separate $500 refundable deposit.

title: Trade-in appraisals
text: A trade-in appraisal is done in person at either location and takes about 30 minutes, including a short test drive. The online trade estimate tool gives a range only and is not an offer. A written appraisal is valid for 5 days or 250 miles, whichever comes first, and only toward a vehicle purchase from us. We also buy vehicles outright without a purchase, but a cash offer is valid for 3 days and is usually lower. The appraisal assumes the condition seen on the day, so new damage or new warning lights cancel it. Bring the title, or if there is a loan, the lender's name, your account number and a 10-day payoff letter; we pay off the loan directly, and any positive equity goes toward your purchase. Negative equity can be added to a new loan, subject to lender approval, or paid at signing. A missing second key reduces the offer by $300, and a missing owner's manual or navigation card by $50 each. All registered owners must sign the title at the time of trade. Leased vehicles can be traded in with a written buyout quote from the leasing company.

title: Financing: what to bring and how applications work
text: We arrange financing through a panel of banks and credit unions and the manufacturer's own finance company; we do not lend money directly. A credit application can be started online and is valid for 30 days, after which a new application and credit check are needed. To complete a financed purchase, bring a valid driver's license; your three most recent pay stubs, or if you are self-employed, your last two years of tax returns plus three months of business bank statements; proof of residence dated within the last 30 days, such as a utility bill or bank statement in your name; and proof of full-coverage insurance on the new vehicle, with the lender named as loss payee, before you can drive away. Retirees can bring a benefits award letter instead of pay stubs. Down payments of up to $2,500 can be made by debit or credit card; larger amounts must be paid by cashier's check, bank transfer or personal check, and a personal check over $2,500 holds the vehicle until it clears, usually 3 business days. Co-applicants must come in person to sign. The first payment is normally due 45 days after the purchase date, and none of the lenders we work with charge a prepayment penalty.

title: Seasonal tire changeover and tire storage
text: Tire storage is offered at the Brookmere service department only. Storage costs $119 per season for a set of four tires, mounted on wheels or not, and includes cleaning, a tread and pressure check, and storage in a climate-controlled room. Winter tires are stored from 1 April to 31 October, and summer or all-season tires from 1 November to 31 March. A seasonal changeover when your other set is already mounted on wheels costs $69, including a tire pressure monitor reset. If the tires have to be dismounted and mounted on one set of wheels, it costs $139 including balancing. Changeover appointments must be booked at least 3 business days ahead, and no walk-in changeovers are done between 15 October and 15 December. Tires left in storage more than 30 days after the end of their season are charged $25 per month, and tires still unclaimed 6 months after the season ends are disposed of after one written notice. We will not store tires with less than 4/32 inch of tread left; we will recommend replacing them instead. Tire storage customers get 10 percent off new tires bought from us.

title: Hybrid and electric vehicle service
text: Hybrid and battery-electric Vantrell models, including the Solano Hybrid and the Lumeo EV, are serviced at Harlan Falls by technicians certified for high-voltage systems; Brookmere can do tires, wipers and cabin filters on these models but no high-voltage work. The hybrid battery on Vantrell hybrids is warranted for 10 years or 150,000 miles from the original in-service date, whichever comes first, and this coverage transfers to later owners at no charge. The Lumeo EV's high-voltage battery is warranted for 8 years or 100,000 miles against defects and against capacity falling below 70 percent. A high-voltage battery health check costs $89 and is free once a year for vehicles on a CarePath plan. Recommended EV maintenance: cabin filter every 15,000 miles, brake fluid every 3 years, battery coolant at 150,000 miles, and tire rotation every 7,500 miles; Lumeo tires tend to wear faster because of the vehicle's weight. Customers may use the two Level 2 chargers at Harlan Falls free of charge while their vehicle is in for service. If an EV arrives with less than 10 percent charge, a $20 charging fee may apply so it can be tested.

title: Collision center: estimates, insurance and repair warranty
text: The collision center is on the Harlan Falls campus and repairs all makes, not only Vantrell. Estimates are free. Walk-in estimates are taken on Tuesday and Thursday mornings from 8 am to 11 am; at all other times an estimate needs an appointment, which takes about 30 minutes. A written estimate is valid for 30 days. Hidden damage is often found once panels are removed, so the final bill may be higher; we will not do extra work without your approval or your insurer's approval of a supplement. You have the right to choose your repair shop. We bill your insurer directly only if the insurer is enrolled in our direct billing program; ask us to check yours. With direct billing you pay only your deductible, collected when you pick up the vehicle. With an insurer that is not in the program, you pay the full invoice at pickup and are reimbursed by your insurer. Storage charges of $65 per day begin 3 days after we tell you the repair is complete, or 3 days after an insurer declares the vehicle a total loss. All collision repairs carry a written warranty on workmanship and paint for as long as you own the vehicle.

title: Hours by department and after-hours key drop
text: Harlan Falls campus, 1400 Riverside Parkway: new vehicle sales Monday to Friday 9 am to 8 pm, Saturday 9 am to 6 pm, Sunday 11 am to 5 pm. Service and parts Monday to Friday 7 am to 6 pm and Saturday 8 am to 2 pm, closed Sunday. Collision center Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm, closed weekends. Brookmere pre-owned center and express service, 220 Mill Street: pre-owned sales Monday to Saturday 9 am to 7 pm, closed Sunday; express service Monday to Friday 7 am to 3 pm, closed weekends. Both locations close on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. After-hours key drop: both service departments have a secure key drop box by the service entrance. Fill in an envelope with your name, phone number, mileage and the work needed, seal the key inside and drop it in the box. Vehicles left after hours are checked in the next business day and stay at the owner's risk until then, so do not leave valuables inside. Key drop is not accepted for vehicles dropped off for the collision center or for vehicles under a do-not-drive recall; call ahead for those. The main number for all departments is 555-0142.
